title: Refuse a move from a standby that acked a later epoch than its state
goal: A standby whose own lease acks show a later coordinator ran never takes over from its older state
acceptance: A committed test fails first: B runs epoch 3 renewing through C, the owner re-targets to C at epoch 4, C is refused with standby_behind (test/coordinator-partition.test.ts, mixed epochs)
checkRelocationReadiness refuses before the service stops when standby_lease_state holds a later epoch than the candidate store
privacy: Neutral fixtures only in git; real coordinator state, keys and device evidence remain private.
validation: A committed regression fails before the fix (test/coordinator-partition.test.ts, mixed epochs)
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
Never let two coordinators act, or copy context as authority, to make progress
